note: Test specifications, not test results. Delivered tool test evidence is separate.

tests.title: Deterministic state and identity
tests.stimulus: Feed observations with duplicate IDs, changing generations and reused names.
tests.oracle: Assert unique scoped identities, ordered snapshots and rejection of late results for replaced entities.
tests.safety: No native/disruptive actions are run by this catalog. Native jobs require explicit grants and recovery access.

tests.title: Orthogonal validity states
tests.stimulus: Retain a value, fail the next acquisition, advance fake time, then remove the entity.
tests.oracle: Assert retained value, acquisition error, freshness and presence remain independently visible; no synthetic zero.
tests.safety: No native/disruptive actions are run by this catalog. Native jobs require explicit grants and recovery access.

tests.title: Clock and epoch boundaries
tests.stimulus: Step UTC backward, advance monotonic time, resume/reboot the producer.
tests.oracle: Durations remain monotonic within an epoch and cross-epoch rates/replay are reset or marked gaps.
tests.safety: No native/disruptive actions are run by this catalog. Native jobs require explicit grants and recovery access.

tests.title: Notification race and storm
tests.stimulus: Emit indications before/during initial enumeration and continuously during a slow query.
tests.oracle: Final generation is reconciled without indefinite debounce; callback work and concurrency remain bounded.
tests.safety: No native/disruptive actions are run by this catalog. Native jobs require explicit grants and recovery access.

tests.title: Shared acquisition demand
tests.stimulus: Bind several widgets and a recorder to the same field; remove and add consumers.
tests.oracle: Measure one shared source schedule at combined demand; recorder persists independently of visible widgets.
tests.safety: No native/disruptive actions are run by this catalog. Native jobs require explicit grants and recovery access.

tests.title: Network device/interface/IP join
tests.stimulus: Enable/disable physical and virtual adapters, change link and assign multiple v4/v6 addresses.
tests.oracle: Compare independent native sources; disabled devices and intermediate states survive, names/indices are not sole identities.
tests.safety: No native/disruptive actions are run by this catalog. Native jobs require explicit grants and recovery access.

tests.title: DNS and protocol-unbound changes
tests.stimulus: Change only resolver configuration and exercise an adapter without bound IP on admitted images.
tests.oracle: Record which notifications fire; verify declared fallback/freshness without asserting nonexistent one-second coverage.

tests.title: Connectivity assessment scope
tests.stimulus: Combine isolated Ethernet, routed Wi-Fi, VPN, v4-only/v6-only and optional target probe.
tests.oracle: Source/family/interface and tested destination remain explicit; Wi-Fi success does not make isolated Ethernet Internet-connected.

tests.title: Rate and counter semantics
tests.stimulus: Feed counter deltas, wraps, resets, elapsed-time changes and processor-group data.
tests.oracle: Rates use the actual interval and declared aggregation; reset/unknown never appears as a valid giant spike.

tests.oracle: Labels/units match source quantities; a missing counter or denied query is not zero.
